name: se.novoterm/translation
title: Novoterm Translation
description: MCP server exposing Novoterm Translation's services, industries, landing pages, case studies, videos, team, FAQ and articles as read-only callable tools for AI agents. A submit_contact_inquiry action that submits Novoterm's real contact form on a user's behalf is available when enabled on the deployment. Novoterm is a Stockholm-based translation and language-review agency.
